proposed_facts.reason: Canonical adapter and callee confirm unconditional forwarding, character friction, strict above-walk-speed comparison, configured multiplication, and ordered friction/movement calls. Equality skips multiplication; strengthening is not established.
Canonical L-Gun, Fire Flower, and Scope Start ground Phys callbacks invoke this adapter. The qualified friction description matches its callee without assuming a multiplier greater than one.

Canonical implementation selects the stated joint, copies the point, conditionally applies reciprocal Y scale to all components, and performs a matrix point transform. Both matrix implementations include translation; universal nonuniform-scale cancellation is correctly excluded.

All three cited shooting-item consumers obtain item offsets, call the transform, and use the result for firing or effects. Uniform-scale compensation remains explicitly conditional on an unproved matrix invariant.

Copy-before-output supports identical valid input/output vectors. No local pointer-chain, index, zero-scale, or finite-value checks or pointer retention occur. The joint accessor asserts and invokes matrix setup. Target exceptional floating-point behavior is appropriately deferred.

Canonical helper has only the animation predicate guard; completion selects Fall for GA_Air and ft_8008A2BC otherwise. Both L-Gun callbacks call directly, while Fire Flower guards the invocation by item presence and delegates its air callback to the ground callback.
